references.text: Describes the ritual on the Day of Atonement where the high priest is to put blood on the horns of the altar and make atonement for it, which elaborates on how the atonement in Exod 30:10 was to be carried out.
Gives detailed instructions about the annual Day of Atonement as a permanent statute, which is the same yearly atonement mentioned in Exod 30:10.
Refers to the tenth day of the seventh month as the Day of Atonement, the same annual event where atonement was to be made on the altar of incense.
Describes how the priest is to put blood on the horns of the altar of incense, illustrating the use of sin offering blood on the horns of the altar.
Provides the context for the altar of incense that the atonement in verse 10 refers to, including its placement and construction.
Refers to the high priest entering the Most Holy Place once a year with blood to make atonement, which is the New Testament explanation of the annual atonement.
Contrasts Christ's final sacrifice with the high priest's yearly offering, showing how the annual atonement in Exod 30:10 pointed forward to Christ's perfect sacrifice.
Explains that the repeated yearly sacrifices could not make the worshippers perfect but were a reminder of sin, providing theological context for the annual atonement.
Describes atonement for the sanctuary because of Israel's impurities, showing the holy character of the atonement ritual referred to as 'most holy to the Lord'.
Lev 16:11 shows the concrete fulfillment of the requirement in Exod 30:10 to make atonement with blood before approaching the sanctuary.
Repetition of the first step of the ritual, which is necessary to fulfill the requirement in Exod 30:10 for atonement on the horns.
Lev 16:34 confirms that the annual Day of Atonement established in Exod 30:10 is a permanent statute that was fulfilled.
Lev 16:18 is the concrete fulfillment of the command in Exod 30:10 to put blood on the horns of the altar.
Lev 23:27 defines the timing (the tenth day) for the annual atonement required in Exod 30:10.
